 Caleb Wilson Medical Update
 Bulls.com November 12, 2026 3:57 PM CST Chicago Bulls forward Caleb Wilson sustained a fracture in his right hand during Wednesday night’s game versus the San Antonio Spurs.
 Wilson underwent successful surgery today and will be re-evaluated in three weeks. Updates will be provided as appropriate.
